verdicts.reason: Both share the same broken structure: the Meridian logo has been pulled out of the blue panel onto the busy photo, and its 'n' butts into the panel edge. The sunglasses are cropped at the top-left, and the panel is jammed against the top of the canvas. A's 'Find a Fare' CTA spills past the panel's bottom-right corner and crowds the badge. B keeps the CTA inside the panel, but it shrinks to an illegible pill jammed against the end of the body copy, and the badge text is also smaller. A's CTA is at least readable.
